newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Danish 97 c/a surplus put at 12.0 bln Dkk.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Danish 97 c/a surplus put at 12.0 bln Dkk.

text.p: The Danish Economy Ministry said in its latest report on Tuesday that it expected a 1997 current account surplus of 12.0 billion crowns, rising to 13.0 billion crowns in 1998.
In its previous report last December, the ministry forecast a current account surplus this year of 13.0 billion crowns, rising to 14.0 billion crowns in 1998.
In 1996, Denmark had a current account surplus of 12.3 billion crowns. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
